name: Submit Password Sign-In
summary: Attempts password authentication for an anonymous session without exposing whether the submitted account exists.

requiredInputs.description: Email address submitted for password authentication.
Password credential supplied through the deterministic credential UI.

sourceReferences.note: Typed flow handler executes the password sign-in operation and selects the canonical result transition.
Manager performs password authentication and preserves distinct internal audit evidence while normalizing unknown-account and invalid-password public rejection.
Password Sign In reconciliation models password submission as one action with Success, Rejected, and Locked Out outcomes.
